jobs.title: Creative Designer — Generative AI
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative, AI-native Designer who combines strong visual design fundamentals with advanced hands-on experience using Generative AI tools.

This is not a traditional graphic design role. The ideal candidate actively uses AI as part of the creative process—moving rapidly from concept to high-quality visual execution across branding, campaigns, digital experiences, presentations, video, motion, and social content.

The candidate should be equally comfortable developing a creative concept from scratch and using AI to dramatically accelerate and elevate its execution.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop compelling creative concepts, visual identities, campaigns, and digital experiences.
- Use Generative AI extensively for image generation, video, animation, ideation, storyboarding, design exploration, and production.
- Translate briefs and strategic ideas into strong visual narratives and creative directions.
- Create high-quality assets for:
- Brand and corporate communications
- Digital and social campaigns
- Websites and interactive experiences
- Presentations and pitch decks
- Events and experiential concepts
- Video, motion graphics, and short-form content
- Develop sophisticated prompts and workflows to achieve consistent, production-quality AI-generated outputs.
- Combine AI-generated assets with traditional design techniques to produce polished final work.
- Experiment continuously with emerging AI creative technologies and introduce new capabilities into the team's workflow.
- Work with creative, strategy, marketing, technology, and production teams from concept through final delivery.
- Maintain strong standards for brand consistency, visual quality, originality, and accuracy.

AI & Creative Toolset

Candidates should have strong experience with several of the following:

Generative AI

- Midjourney
- Adobe Firefly
- ChatGPT / GPT image generation
- Google Gemini
- Flux
- Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI

AI Video & Motion

- Runway
- Kling
- Veo
- Higgsfield
- Luma
- Sora or equivalent emerging platforms

Professional Creative Tools

- Adobe Photoshop
- Illustrator
- After Effects
- Premiere Pro
- Figma

Experience building multi-tool AI workflows rather than relying on a single platform is highly desirable.

Required Profile

- Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design and creative thinking.
- Demonstrable portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted creative work.
- Strong understanding of composition, typography, branding, color, visual hierarchy, and storytelling.
- Advanced understanding of prompt engineering for creative production.
- Ability to maintain character, product, environment, and visual-style consistency across AI-generated assets.
- Ability to move rapidly from idea → prototype → refinement → production.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to recognize when AI-generated work is visually impressive but commercially unusable.
- Comfortable experimenting with new tools and adapting as the Generative AI landscape evolves.

What We Are Looking For

We want a designer who sees AI as a creative multiplier, not a replacement for design thinking.

The successful candidate should be able to take a simple brief and use a combination of creative direction, design expertise, Generative AI, motion, and storytelling to produce work that would traditionally require significantly larger creative and production teams.

Portfolio requirement: Applicants should submit both traditional design work and examples demonstrating how they have incorporated Generative AI into their creative process.

About Pechka

Pechka is a Dubai food brand built on Russian and Eastern European home-style cooking. We started with pies baked to family recipes. Today we have a café and bakery in Dubai Marina, delivery and pickup from Dubai Marina, Business Bay and Arjan, and our own production facility supplying wholesale and B2B customers, including retail chains.
Customers order through our website and app (with a rewards programme) and through Talabat, Deliveroo, Careem, Noon, Keeta and Instashop. We also cater corporate and private events, and Pechka Market delivers Eastern European groceries alongside our food.
The role

You will own the Pechka brand and make sure it feels the same everywhere: in the café, in delivery, on packaging, on social media, at events and pop-ups, and on supermarket shelves. You will lead a team of three (digital and SEO, delivery-platform marketing, content and community) plus freelancers, reporting directly to the owner. You will work closely with the FMCG manager, sales, kitchen, production and operations.
What you’ll do

Brand
Develop the brand platform: positioning, values, story, audiences, personality and tone of voice in English and Russian
Shape the brand architecture across Pechka, Pechka Market, catering and the production range, and own naming and positioning of new lines
Maintain the visual identity and brand book, and approve all layouts: menus, packaging, signage, website, app, advertising and B2B materials
Act as creative director: brief and sign off photographers, designers and agencies
Write brand standards for partners and franchisees
Study customers and the market to understand how Pechka is perceived and where to go next

Content and social
Plan and run photo and video shoots for dishes, catering and products
Create content hands-on: short videos (Reels, TikTok), social graphics, banners, menus and presentations
Own Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Telegram, including content plans, community replies and user-generated content

PR, events and pop-ups
Work with media and pitch stories (family recipes, seasonal launches, new products)
Select, brief and measure bloggers and influencers
Build partnerships and take part in cultural, charity and community projects
Organise tastings, launches, masterclasses and celebrations such as Maslenitsa
Help run pop-up stores: concept, stand design, range and pricing, logistics, promotion and results
Own the brand’s reputation, including crisis communications

Products, menu and pricing (with kitchen and production)
Propose new dishes and products based on sales, feedback and trends
Plan seasonal menus and launches a year ahead (Maslenitsa, Easter, Ramadan, New Year)
Run tastings, keep costings current, control food cost and margin
Propose prices for each channel, allowing for commissions and retailer margins

Packaging and retail
Own packaging concept, design, suppliers and cost for delivery, catering and retail
Work with the FMCG manager to meet UAE labelling and product registration requirements
Define how the brand looks on shelf and in B2B: labels, catalogues, buyer presentations and trade-show stands (e.g. Gulfood)

Delivery platforms and direct orders
Manage relationships with platform account managers and keep menus, photos, descriptions and prices accurate
Approve platform ads and promotions, measure returns and stop what doesn’t pay
Track ratings, cancellations and complaints and fix causes with operations
Run advertising on social media, Google and with influencers; grow orders through our own website and app; oversee SEO and Google Business Profiles

Handle complex customer cases and turn repeat complaints into fixes
Run the loyalty programme (tiers, cashback points, welcome and birthday offers, gift cards, promo codes) and track its economics
Build email, SMS and WhatsApp communications: segments, trigger flows and win-back campaigns
Track retention, order frequency, average order value and churn

Catering
Build the catering offer with the kitchen and sales, prepare sales materials, and generate leads through digital channels, outreach and venue partnerships

Budget and team
Own the marketing budget across all business lines and report monthly on spend and results
Lead and develop the marketing team and freelancers

Note: negotiations with retail chains and B2B clients are handled by the FMCG manager and sales team and are not part of this role.
Your first 90 days

Month 1: a brand audit across every touchpoint, an audit of the loyalty programme, and meetings with key internal teams and platform account managers
Month 2: first fixes (consistent menus, photos and prices across channels, a review-response routine, a 12-month seasonal calendar, refreshed catering materials)
Month 3: the brand concept for the coming years and a 12-month marketing plan with budget, targets and loyalty plan, plus a proposal for team structure

What you bring

5+ years in brand management or marketing, including 3+ years in food (restaurants, delivery, catering, FMCG) or at a branding agency with food clients
Proven experience creating or developing a brand concept (positioning, brand platform, visual identity, brand book), with portfolio examples
Experience running a loyalty programme and CRM marketing: mechanics, economics, segmentation, email, SMS and WhatsApp, retention analysis
PR experience across media, influencers and events
Hands-on video and graphics skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar; Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva) and the ability to prepare and check print-ready files
A trained eye for design and photography, and a palate the team can trust at tastings
Team leadership experience and a track record of working with freelancers, agencies and sales teams

A calm, fair approach to handling customer complaints
Multilingual: fluent English is required. Professional-level Russian is a strong advantage, as our brand communicates in both English and Russian

Nice to have

Experience with delivery platforms (Talabat, Deliveroo, Careem, Noon, Keeta, Yandex Eda, Wolt, Glovo)
Experience with Brevo or similar email and messaging platforms

Arabic

UAE employment visa
Medical insurance
Paid annual leave

Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work, and we strive to provide all candidates with an unbiased and accessible recruitment process. If you require assistance due to a disability when applying please let us know in your application so we can accommodate your needs.

You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.

You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.

Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.

Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.

Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.

Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.

Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.

Full-funnel creative thinking

Strong creative + strategy partnership

Global thinking

Lifestyle and culture

Range

Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

new_jobs.title: Creative Director - Wellness & Lifestyle
new_jobs.description:
Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.
Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.
Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.
Strong photography and film production experience.
Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.
Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.
Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.
Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.
We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Languages

English (mandatory)
Spanish (preferably)
Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.
Three weeks of remote work per year.
Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).
Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.
Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.
Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.
Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.
Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.
A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

At Dragons Group, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and strive to build an environment where every individual feels empowered and respected.
